failures.summary: UF-03 and UF-11 timed out inside application.launch while XCTest reported the production app as Running Background

observed: Both selected tests remained blocked at the XCUIApplication launch boundary; neither test flow initialized or executed an assertion.
interpretation: The delayed activate-regardless coordinator did not stabilize Xcode Cloud foreground launch. This is a platform-runner failure and does not prove a product-flow failure.
cleanup: The falsified product-side launch coordinator and both activation variants were removed from staging.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Keep Xcode Cloud manual and non-required; use the bounded focused local lane after the owner accepts macOS UI-testing authentication, then validate the exact installed artifact separately.
